public_symbol_parity.adaptation: C callback/context pair becomes an optional lifetime-borrowed FnMut; cancellation is reported on DecodeFailure and partial view state is dropped.
C output pointer becomes Result<TimelineView<'source>>; all returned source slices are lifetime-bound.
C out-parameter/boolean becomes Option<TrackView>; string fields remain raw JSON contents and borrow original source.
C out-parameter/boolean becomes Option<ItemView>; source span is vexel_base::Span and payload bytes borrow source.
Iterator state is safe value metadata; one forward JSON scan per item, bound to a single track until reset.

Caller-owned mutable slice replaces pointer+length output; returns decoded byte count only on success, writes bounded UTF-8 without allocation, and rejects decoded output above 4096 bytes even when the output slice is larger.
Rust Result success carries no error enum; all failure names match C spellings.

named_helper_parity.details: Exact fields, tick range/order, drawing asset MIME, labels, scalar/transform2d/rgba/boolean values, duplicate ticks and references.
Bounded streaming scan with checked reservation; one temporary item-span table per track, capped at 100000.
JSON whitespace is the four permitted ASCII bytes; cancellation polls at 4096-byte source offsets.
UTF-8 validity, all JSON escapes, paired surrogate validation, decoded 4096-byte limit in both the public copy helper and parser, and exact caller-buffer capacity behavior.
Rust finite f64 parsing is locale-independent; JSON lexical grammar and 96-byte numeric token bound are enforced.
Nesting limit 32, object field limit 16, decoded duplicate-key detection, malformed JSON and cancellation.

named_helper_parity.rust: byte-slice equality/order and decoded Field.key comparisons
named_helper_parity.details: Rust u8 slice ordering matches unsigned-byte C memcmp ordering.
Preserves raw JSON source spans; decoded strings are only materialized for comparison and reference checks.
Capacity enforced before adding each span; no shared DOM/token cap is imposed.
Indexed access scans from the array start; sequential access resumes from its saved cursor and does not rescan prior items.

safe_ownership_adaptations: C source pointer+length becomes &'source [u8]; TimelineView privately retains the borrow and immutable Span metadata.
Fixed 256-entry stack arrays become fallibly reserved Vec metadata capped at the same count; at most one 100000-span item array is temporary at a time.
Borrowed scene/asset pointer records become owned TimelineContext vectors validated for limits, uniqueness and sorted unsigned-byte scene order.
C zero-initialized public iterator becomes TimelineIterator::default; invalid track reuse returns None and reset replaces state with default.
No unsafe code, C shim, new dependency, system package, external algorithm or unsupported-OS code was introduced.

acceptance_review_repairs.string_copy_limit: Regression asserts 4096 decoded bytes succeeds and 4097 fails with an 8192-byte output buffer.
acceptance_review_repairs.validation_cancellation: The callback is propagated through object_fields, array_spans, and typed-array rescans; a later-pass cancellation asserts canceled=true and source offset 131072.
acceptance_review_repairs.exact_error_offsets: Duplicate escaped key offset is asserted at the second encoded key; malformed high/invalid-low surrogate offset is asserted at the cursor after the low code unit.

remaining_product_scope: This crate ports timeline decoding, classification, immutable access, iteration and string copying only. Native timeline edit/session/playback/render behavior, application integration, and the overall Rust product finish line remain separate work.
